scientific_question: On the next globally unopened eligible BLASTNet vitiated-H2-air condition in the original v75 metadata ordering, does the already fixed v229 target-rig-blind dual-PRESS envelope accept enough direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 cells to reduce exact calls while preserving every frozen field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, observation, matched-accuracy, complete-rig-tail, and safety gate against zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16?
evidence_role: One-shot prospective same-family confirmation of the fixed v229 observable calibration. It is not broad external-family generalization, a learned algorithm, wall/RSS evidence, curved-ray validation, real BOST, paper success, or an algorithm breakthrough.

already_opened_before_v230.evidence: v75 external sentinel and later development
v85 external batch and v86-v110 post-open development
v207 external gate and later development
v219 acquisition/opening and v220-v229 post-open development

sealed_parent_calibration.calibration_source: All thirteen opened Case 5 rigs only; no Case 12 score, rig identity, metric, truth, or aggregate enters calibration.
sealed_parent_calibration.accept_rule: accept direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 iff min(raw_PRESS/raw_threshold, studentized_PRESS/studentized_threshold) <= envelope_multiplier; equality accepts; otherwise use zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16

selected_public_dataset.description: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 12
selected_public_dataset.boundary_conditions: inflow and outflow in source x, periodic in source y and z

fixed_inverse_problem.source_to_reconstruction_axes: source x -> reconstruction z, source y -> reconstruction y, source z -> reconstruction x
fixed_inverse_problem.rig_ids_and_camera_orders: exactly the thirteen clean virtual-nine rigs sealed by v209
fixed_inverse_problem.low64_basis: same fixed orthonormal physical Low-64 span used by v214-v229
fixed_inverse_problem.reported_geometry_proxy: unregularized Moore-Penrose fit in the reported-geometry Low-64 response
fixed_inverse_problem.preconditioner: same exact reported-geometry Jacobi diagonal with relative floor 1e-6

observable_scores.camera_block_order: reported camera order; score is permutation invariant

prediction_and_truth_barrier.stage_1: A dedicated observation builder may open Case 12 raw rho and grids only after independently validated acquisition; it writes the 13x46 synthetic observation tensor and exits.
prediction_and_truth_barrier.stage_2: A separate predictor process receives only sealed observations, reported geometry, frozen Low-64 basis, fixed calibration, and solver code. It writes both parent scores, envelope, decisions, direct-K11 field/residual, zero-K16 field/residual, and call ledgers before any target truth metric is available to that process.
prediction_and_truth_barrier.stage_3: A separate scorer may then open Case 12 truth, verify prediction seals, compute metrics and policy tails, and may not alter scores, thresholds, decisions, fields, residuals, or calls.

independent_validation.second_preprocessor: independent grid-axis extraction and interpolation indices
independent_validation.second_low64_solver: normal-matrix eigendecomposition rather than formal response SVD
independent_validation.second_studentized_score: Woodbury quadratic evaluation rather than formal predictive-covariance Cholesky whitening
independent_validation.second_calibration_application: literal fixed constants and explicit scalar loops

decision_order: invalid selection, acquisition, opening, rank, observation, covariance, barrier, source, seal, call, permutation, or independent-recomputation check -> INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE12_DUAL_PRESS_EXTERNAL_V230

any unsafe accepted direct K11 cell, any rig below five accepted frames, any cell or complete-rig policy accuracy failure, or any per-rig exact-call failure -> FAIL_CASE12_NESTED_DUAL_PRESS_EXTERNAL_V230
all validity, reference, safety, utility, policy accuracy, per-rig exact-call, and independent gates pass -> PASS_CASE12_NESTED_DUAL_PRESS_PROSPECTIVE_CONFIRMATION_V230
